fullText.simplified:
第三章、北极熊的脚印

    孙林继续和何小宇聊着，他一边观察着何小宇的反应，一边考虑着去现场看看。看到何小宇失望的表情，孙林安慰他说：“我绝对相信你，小宇。你可以带我去北极熊那个展厅看看吗？”
    何小宇点了点头，他带着孙林去了博物馆的二楼。整个展厅不算太大，展厅的一边放着一个大型非洲猩猩的标本，另一边没有东西。那儿应该就是放大型北极熊标本的地方吧。孙林朝屋顶看了看，屋里的灯很暗，也没有安装摄像头。
    “小宇，这个展厅没安装摄像头吗？”孙林问道。
    何小宇站在靠近门口的地方，正犹豫着要不要进去。听到孙林问他，他耸了耸肩膀，回答道：“没安装。这儿之前是空的，最近来了两个大型标本，就暂时放在这儿了。”
    孙林思考了一下，指了指大猩猩标本说：“是这个大猩猩和北极熊标本吗？”
    何小宇点点头。
    孙林走到何小宇身边，安慰着他：“小宇，你别紧张。你能想想那天晚上你看到了什么吗？具体点儿，好吗？”
    何小宇做了一个深呼吸，慢慢地说道：“那天晚上十二点，我上楼检查各个展厅，走到这儿附近的时候……我……我看到北极熊的影子在动。”
    “影子？你只看到了影子，对吗？”孙林歪了一下头，问道。
    “不，我其实很害怕，不想进来。但……但这毕竟是我的工作，所以我最后还是咬着牙进来了。我看见北极熊从那个窗户跳了出去。”何小宇说完，指了指对面的窗户。
    “你有没有看到别的什么人？或者别的什么东西？”孙林问道。
    “没有。我也跑到窗边看了，就只看到那只巨大的北极熊跑……跑远了。”何小宇回忆着那晚的事情，他吓得声音有点儿抖。
    孙林跑到窗边看了看，外面的草地上有泥，泥地上有一些巨大的脚印。孙林连忙跑到外面的草地上查看。他观察了周围的草地，显然这里只有一些非常巨大的脚印，像熊的脚印，没有人的鞋印。这是怎么回事？北极熊真的活了？这不合理啊！
    孙林站起来，抖了抖身上的泥。他没想到这次的调查超出了他的想象。他本来打算尽快调查清楚这件事，然后再发表一篇文章报道此事。现在市里大家都对这件事议论纷纷，很多人都在讨论这个神秘的北极熊到底去哪儿了。但是他现在不知道要如何写这篇文章了，难道要写“经过跟博物馆保安的了解，北极熊标本真的活了”？

第三章、北極熊的腳印

    孫林繼續和何小宇聊著，他一邊觀察著何小宇的反應，一邊考慮著去現場看看。看到何小宇失望的表情，孫林安慰他說：“我絕對相信你，小宇。你可以帶我去北極熊那個展廳看看嗎？”
    何小宇點了點頭，他帶著孫林去了博物館的二樓。整個展廳不算太大，展廳的一邊放著一個大型非洲猩猩的標本，另一邊沒有東西。那兒應該就是放大型北極熊標本的地方吧。孫林朝屋頂看了看，屋裡的燈很暗，也沒有安裝攝像頭。
    “小宇，這個展廳沒安裝攝像頭嗎？”孫林問道。
    何小宇站在靠近門口的地方，正猶豫著要不要進去。聽到孫林問他，他聳了聳肩膀，回答道：“沒安裝。這兒之前是空的，最近來了兩個大型標本，就暫時放在這兒了。”
    孫林思考了一下，指了指大猩猩標本說：“是這個大猩猩和北極熊標本嗎？”
    何小宇點點頭。
    孫林走到何小宇身邊，安慰著他：“小宇，你別緊張。你能想想那天晚上你看到了什麼嗎？具體點兒，好嗎？”
    何小宇做了一個深呼吸，慢慢地說道：“那天晚上十二點，我上樓檢查各個展廳，走到這兒附近的時候……我……我看到北極熊的影子在動。”
    “影子？你只看到了影子，對嗎？”孫林歪了一下頭，問道。
    “不，我其實很害怕，不想進來。但……但這畢竟是我的工作，所以我最後還是咬著牙進來了。我看見北極熊從那個窗戶跳了出去。”何小宇說完，指了指對面的窗戶。
    “你有沒有看到別的什麼人？或者別的什麼東西？”孫林問道。
    “沒有。我也跑到窗邊看了，就只看到那隻巨大的北極熊跑……跑遠了。”何小宇回憶著那晚的事情，他嚇得聲音有點兒抖。
    孫林跑到窗邊看了看，外面的草地上有泥，泥地上有一些巨大的腳印。孫林連忙跑到外面的草地上查看。他觀察了周圍的草地，顯然這裡只有一些非常巨大的腳印，像熊的腳印，沒有人的鞋印。這是怎麼回事？北極熊真的活了？這不合理啊！
    孫林站起來，抖了抖身上的泥。他沒想到這次的調查超出了他的想像。他本來打算盡快調查清楚這件事，然後再發表一篇文章報道此事。現在市裡大家都對這件事議論紛紛，很多人都在討論這個神秘的北極熊到底去哪兒了。但是他現在不知道要如何寫這篇文章了，難道要寫“經過跟博物館保安的了解，北極熊標本真的活了”？

sentences.pinyin: tā běn lái dǎ suàn jǐn kuài diào chá qīng chu zhè jiàn shì rán hòu zài fā biǎo yì piān wén zhāng bào dào cǐ shì
sentences.english: He had planned to investigate the matter as soon as possible and then publish an article reporting it.

sentences.simplified: 现在市里大家都对这件事议论纷纷，很多人都在讨论这个神秘的北极熊到底去哪儿了。
sentences.traditional: 現在市裡大家都對這件事議論紛紛，很多人都在討論這個神秘的北極熊到底去哪兒了。
sentences.pinyin: xiàn zài shì lǐ dà jiā dōu duì zhè jiàn shì yì lùn fēn fēn hěn duō rén dōu zài tǎo lùn zhè ge shén mì de běi jí xióng dào dǐ qù nǎ'r le
sentences.english: Now everyone in the city was talking about it. Many people were discussing where this mysterious polar bear had gone.

sentences.simplified: 但是他现在不知道要如何写这篇文章了，
sentences.traditional: 但是他現在不知道要如何寫這篇文章了，
sentences.pinyin: dàn shì tā xiàn zài bù zhī dào yào rú hé xiě zhè piān wén zhāng le
sentences.english: But now he didn’t know how to write this article.

sentences.simplified: 难道要写“经过跟博物馆保安的了解，北极熊标本真的活了”？
sentences.traditional: 難道要寫“經過跟博物館保安的了解，北極熊標本真的活了”？
sentences.pinyin: nán dào yào xiě jīng guò gēn bó wù guǎn bǎo ān de liǎo jiě běi jí xióng biāo běn zhēn de huó le
sentences.english: How could he write: “According to the museum security guard, the polar bear specimen is really alive”?

sentence_translations: Chapter 3: Polar Bear Paw Prints
Sun Lin continued to chat with He Xiaoyu. He observed Xiaoyu’s reactions and thought about visiting the scene.
Seeing He Xiaoyu’s disappointed expression, Sun Lin consoled him:
“I absolutely believe you, Xiaoyu. Can you take me to see the polar bear exhibition hall?”
He Xiaoyu nodded and took Sun Lin to the second floor of the museum.
The whole exhibition hall was not very big. One side of the hall held a specimen of a large African ape, and the other side had nothing.
That’s where the large polar bear specimen should be.
Sun Lin looked at the ceiling. The lights in the room were dim, and no surveillance cameras were installed.
“Xiaoyu, are there any surveillance cameras installed in this exhibition hall?” Sun Lin asked.
He Xiaoyu stood near the door and was hesitating about whether to go in.
When he heard Sun Lin ask the question, he shrugged his shoulders and replied, ..
.. “No. This place was empty before. Two large specimens arrived recently and were temporarily placed here.”
Sun Lin thought for a moment, pointed to the gorilla specimen, and said, “You mean this gorilla and the polar bear specimen?”
He Xiaoyu nodded.
Sun Lin went to He Xiaoyu’s side and comforted him:
“Xiaoyu, don’t be nervous. Can you think of what you saw that night? Can you be more specific?”
He Xiaoyu took a deep breath and said slowly, ..
.. “At midnight that night, I went upstairs to check each of the various exhibition halls.
And when I came here … I … I saw the polar bear’s shadow moving.”
“Shadow? You only saw the shadow, right?” Sun Lin tilted his head and asked.
“No, actually, I was scared and didn’t want to come in.
But … but this is my job, after all, so I finally bit the bullet and came in. I saw the polar bear jump out of that window.”
He Xiaoyu finished speaking and pointed to the opposite window.
“Did you see anyone else? Or anything else?” Sun Lin asked.
“No, I also ran to the window to look and just saw the huge polar bear running … running into the distance.”
As He Xiaoyu recalled the events of that night, he was so scared that his voice shook a little.
Sun Lin ran to the window and looked outside. There was mud on the grass and some huge paw prints on the muddy ground.
Sun Lin rushed to the grass outside to investigate.
He observed the surrounding grass.
It was clear that there were only some very large paw prints, like those of a bear, and no human shoe prints.
What was going on here? The polar bear had really come alive? This was impossible!
Sun Lin stood up and shook the mud from his body. He hadn’t expected this investigation to go beyond his imagination.
He had planned to investigate the matter as soon as possible and then publish an article reporting it.
Now everyone in the city was talking about it. Many people were discussing where this mysterious polar bear had gone.
But now he didn’t know how to write this article.
How could he write: “According to the museum security guard, the polar bear specimen is really alive”?
